text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Across the grueling path testing the maidens!
Gracefully breaking through to cross the line in first is...—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Pathetic!!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...I have engraved it.
Into this body, into this soul... today's defeat."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"I won't call it a stepping stone. Defeat is defeat;
there's no other way forward but to rise from the bottom!"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Let us move forward.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"The Shuka Sho...
I will go and claim the crown that belongs to me."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur... murmur...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Look at Gentildonna.
What incredible drive...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
...Formidable even in defeat, huh.
Her ability is real, and there's no doubt she's leading-lady material.
The Shuka Sho is surely going to be...
choice_data_list: (Everyone's looking at Gentildonna after her loss)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Though she didn't get the result she wanted, everyone watching today acknowledges Gentildonna's overwhelming strength.
choice_data_list: (Next time, I'll definitely lead her to victory...!)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
You worked so hard too, Verxina!!
Great job!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...!
I... did a good job...?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Verxina "too"?
...Second to her?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —...Tch, what a complete humiliation...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...I have to overwhelmingly surpass her.
Otherwise, I'll never be able to overwrite her presence—"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...I won't give it up.
The Shuka Sho—will be MINE!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By the time Gentildonna returned,
she had already regained her composure.
After going over a few reflections from today—
choice_data_list: I'm sorry. I couldn't lead you to victory.
I'm sorry, I couldn't guide you to victory.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
No apology is necessary.
I was the one who lost.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Frustration suddenly welled up within me.
She is strong. Failing to draw out her full potential was entirely my responsibility.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...It's shaping up to be a precious summer,
perfect for growth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume grow by leaps and bounds over the summer.
For that reason, Tracen Academy held a summer training camp aimed at improving their abilities.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
To redeem this defeat,
nothing less than an absolute victory will suffice.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Naturally, you will prepare something from your finest selection, yes?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I feel the pressure radiating from Gentildonna even more
than usual. With each passing night, she grows stronger.
Her extraordinary speed makes me—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Well, how about it?
You're going to push me to greater heights, aren't you?
choice_data_list: Ah, to heights beyond your imagination
Yeah, to heights beyond your imagination.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...
You really said it, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I am not the only one who needs to grow this summer.
I expect you to redouble your efforts as well.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —For the day I shall demonstrate my true strength.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, in order to finish with a flourish at the final crown of the Tiara line, the Shuka Sho...
we will push the training intensity even higher.
